Quick note on offboarding confirmation: our deprovision runbook captures the following checkpoints and timestamps (all of which can be exported as CSV entries):
1) Termination accepted in HRIS -> trigger ticket creation in IAM (ticket id)
2) Account disable + SSO revocation timestamp
3) Access review completion by app owners
4) Device return and asset tag update

We also keep a 90-day retention log for access revocations tied to the ticket id. If Alder wants, we can include a redacted ticket export showing the exact timestamps for one sample case.
